text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During our outing,
we stopped by a variety goods shop.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, a swan keychain.
How cute, hehe.
choice_data_list: It's so cute with that chibi-style art!
It's so cute with that chibi-style art, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Do you think so too, Trainer?
To be honest, I've actually collected
a bunch of swan merchandise.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Putting straps on bags and things.
And decorating the room with trinkets, too.
choice_data_list: Do you like real swans too?
Do you like real swans too?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Floating gracefully on the lake like that looks so cool...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "...Though I say that, I've barely ever seen one in person."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"They're winter migratory birds,
so I never really had the chance to see them.
I was... hospitalized quite often, you see."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm always looking at merch and photos.
Whenever I see them in town, I just can't resist buying them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching K.S. Miracle say that,
an idea suddenly came to me.
choice_data_list: Let's go see a swan that's bigger than the real thing!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I see, a planetarium...!
It's true, you can see a much, much bigger swan
than the real thing there.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
And on top of that, you can look at it casually anytime...
Hehe, I'd never even thought of that!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah, looks like it's about to start...

text_block_list.name: Commentary Audio
text_block_list.text:
"...Next, let us look upon a single bird
gracefully flapping its wings across the Milky Way."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Wah...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary Audio
text_block_list.text:
"Cygnus, forming a beautiful cross,
is a summer constellation. In Japan,
it can be viewed until late October."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (...I see.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Even when it isn't winter, swans are still here.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (To a place much higher in the sky.)

text_block_list.name: Commentary Audio
text_block_list.text:
"From here on, the beautiful swan shall spread its great wings
and continue to soar across the Milky Way above our heads."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ooh...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(From here on out too...
It's like a miracle that keeps on shining.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...It was truly beautiful. Thank you for inviting me.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The explanation of Cygnus was great too...
It really gave me courage.
choice_data_list: Then... I wonder if they'll like this too.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
A Cygnus pin badge?
Wow... Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! I'm sorry!
I didn't notice it at all myself...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
This is kind of embarrassing...
Ahaha.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, come to think of it...
If it's the badges, we can have matching ones, right?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
See, Trainer-san, you're wearing
your Trainer Badge on your chest.
...Fufu, it somehow makes me really happy.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I got something really special, didn't I?
I'll take absolute care of it!
choice_data_list: Let's go buy swan merchandise again!
It would be nice if we could go see the real thing too.
It would be nice if we could go see the real thing too.
I'm curious what else you have.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I got something really special, didn't I?
I'll take absolute care of it!
choice_data_list: Let's go buy swan merchandise again!
It would be nice if we could go see the real thing too.
It would be nice if we could go see the real thing too.
I'm curious what else you have.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes, please.
I want to move these legs of mine and gather it all up.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Besides, the merchandise is great and all, but...
I'm just really looking forward to
going out with you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'm really looking forward to it...
Though if it's too amazing,
I might end up crying.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"When that time comes, Trainer...
please don't laugh, okay?"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Please let me introduce them to you next time!
Ah... but there are really so many of them, I wonder if it'll be okay...?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I might end up taking up
too much of your time, Trainer... Ahaha.
